sections.text:
The type G 20 B motor compressor (figure 2) is designed to supply the compressed air to pneumatically operated switchgear. Figures are included 
 inside this document

items:
Disassemble, clean up, inspect and 
 if necessary replace the intake and delivery valve 
 blades 42 and 58 as well as the related gasket.

Check the cylinder bore for out of 
 round by measuring the diameter with an accurate gauge placed at right angle 
 and parallel to the crankshaft. If the out - of - round is excessive, refinish 
 the cylinder walls dringing the cylinder bore to a diameter equal to the 
 diameter of the new piston with excess clearance of 0.08 mm.

Check the operating time for 
 the circuit breaker opening & closing if the time values dont correspond to 
 those indicated in the factory certificates 30ms/35ms for opening, 60ms for 
 closing if not OK clean the filters, orifices and control valves of the 
 operating mechanisms then measure the operating time again.

With the control circuit at its rated voltage and SF6 air systems at their 
 respective rated pressures, perform same closing and opening operations, 
 recording the operation times with a multi-channel oscillograph.

Measure the SF6 gas moisture if it is in one pole is higher than 
 250 PPMv, the SF6 contained in it must be reconditioned and the
 molecular 
 sieves replaced. ref. MPIS document no. TD-SS-006-r1 and 
 the table no. 1 attached
